ability.final_lanterns.host_nekron.host_: You host Nekron, the lord of the dead. Its power is yours, no ring needed, and it refills on its own, always. Grow it here with XP levels. Give it up with Release or by saying "I release you". Another player can draw it out of you by sneaking with a corps' lantern and staring at you for five seconds. After you lose it, no entity will choose you for an hour.
